patterns: APPSC asks steel plant collaborations (Rourkela - Germany), core industries (transport is not one; refinery products heaviest in 2011-12 series), BEL Navratna, AAI Miniratna-I, guided missiles = BDL.
Recurring traps: IIP compiled by NSO vs ICI by DPIIT; IIP excludes construction/services; old vs new core-industry weights.
Other PSCs heavily test Ratna lists (which PSU is/is not Maharatna/Navratna, BHEL Maharatna 2013) and loss-making CPSEs (BSNL).
APPSC adds AP angles (Krishnapatnam heavy industries, Vizag RINL); app covers these but adds many 2026 IIP/ICI rebasing details not yet tested.
App favours multi-statement items with ES 2025-26 figures; PYQs are single-fact recall.
